items.title: Dashboard
items.help: Main overview with CPU, memory, disk, and package meters for the signed-in user.

items.title: Websites overview
items.help: Website category hub. List is at /websites/list; create is a separate action.

items.title: Websites list
items.help: Searchable list of websites with Manage, package, PHP, and storage details.

items.title: Sub-domains
items.help: Separate sub-domain list under the Website category.

items.title: WordPress
items.help: WordPress hub. Install uses the signed-in CPN username by default.

items.title: Email hub
items.help: Email overview. Accounts live at /email/accounts; password at /email/password.

items.title: Email accounts
items.help: Create and manage mailboxes. Needs Postfix and Dovecot healthy.

items.title: Change email password
items.help: Change mailbox password and optionally sync webmail admin login.

items.title: DKIM
items.help: DKIM material for hosted domains.

items.title: MTA-STS
items.help: Email TLS policy UI. Requires the free mtaSts plugin installed.

items.title: BIMI
items.help: BIMI setup. Requires the free bimi plugin installed.

items.title: Docker overview
items.help: Docker hub tiles. Active containers list is /docker/list.

items.title: Active containers
items.help: List Running (green) and Stopped (red) containers. Create is /docker/create.

items.title: Plugins
items.help: Installed and Store catalog. Host vs Site install target. Host packages such as MariaDB live here too.

items.title: phpMyAdmin
items.help: Panel reverse-proxied phpMyAdmin. Session follows CPN login.

items.title: Root File Manager
items.help: Host root file manager. Site-jailed FileGator is a separate Store plugin.

items.title: Firewall
items.help: Firewall manager. Server and first-admin IPs stay whitelisted.

items.title: Fail2ban
items.help: Fail2ban manager when the fail2ban host plugin is installed.

items.title: Malware scan
items.help: Malware scan. Free path uses ClamAV host plugin; paid API is separate.

items.title: Cloudflare DNS
items.help: Cloudflare DNS linking (OAuth or token). Manage records with search and sort.

items.title: SSL
items.help: SSL is per domain on website manage. Let's Encrypt is the usual free origin cert.

items.title: Settings overview
items.help: Settings hub. Version management, design/themes, site messages, log retention.

items.title: Version management
items.help: Upgrade or downgrade CPN releases and stable tip commits. Shows European dates.

items.title: Design / Theme Store
items.help: Design presets and Theme Store (Installed | Store).

items.title: List users
items.help: Users hub with search, sort, and Manage user modal (Account / Security / Other).

items.title: Account security
items.help: TOTP and Passkeys under Modify User Security. MFA material stays under /var/lib/cpn/mfa/.

items.title: Packages
items.help: Hosting packages: websites, mailboxes, databases, FTP/SFTP, storage, bandwidth. -1 is unlimited.

items.title: Backups
items.help: Backup and restore for CPN, WordPress, cPanel-style, and classic source-panel archives.

items.title: Services
items.help: Service status: Active, Inactive, Enabled, Deactivated, Not installed.

items.title: System Repair
items.help: Solve Problems progressive checks and heals. CLI: cpn doctor.

items.title: PHP extensions
items.help: Install or remove PHP extensions; set host default PHP.

items.title: Open LiteSpeed
items.help: OLS management when installed. WebAdmin is often on port 7080.

items.title: Panel API access
items.help: Issue and revoke Bearer cpn_ tokens for external clients (hashed at rest).

items.title: Mr Agent
items.help: This chat assistant. Free lightweight help needs no provider API key; paid providers use your own keys.
